kind_of_thing.quote: Stygimoloch is a dubious genus of herbivorous dinosaur.

dinosaur_academic.quote: Stygimoloch is a disputed genus of pachycephalosaur (dome-headed dinosaur) from the end of the Cretaceous period, roughly 66 million years ago.

kind_of_dinosaur.quote: Like other pachycephalosaurids, Stygimoloch was a bipedal herbivore with short forelimbs and a thick, domed skull, likely used in intraspecific head-butting.
